CustomField.description: This custom field has been created as part of SFDC to Medallia integration , and will be part of Medallia package Medallia field mapped a_alert_date_close Purpose- To capture date when the CLF Alert was closed. This mirrors the ClosedDate standard field value. This has been created to pass the information to Medallia as closedDate standard field cannot be added to Fieldset - medallia_xm__medalliaOutbound_closeAlert
CustomField.label: Alert Closed Date
